Computer science.fact: == History == The earliest foundations of what would become computer science predate the invention of the modern digital computer. CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: The _____ was Hardware cache of a central processing unit.
CPU cache.fact: A CPU cache is a hardware cache used by the central processing unit (CPU) of a computer to reduce the average cost (time or energy) to access data from the main memory.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: Cache memory is typically implemented with static random-access memory (_____), which requires multiple transistors to store a single bit
CPU cache.fact: Cache memory is typically implemented with static random-access memory (SRAM), which requires multiple transistors to store a single bit. Some modern designs implement some or all of their cache using the physically smaller eDRAM, which is slower to use than SRAM but allows larger amounts of cache for any given amount of chip area.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: Some modern designs implement some or all of their cache using the physically smaller eDRAM, which is slower to use than _____ but allows larger amounts of cache for any given amount of chip area
CPU cache.fact: Cache memory is typically implemented with static random-access memory (SRAM), which requires multiple transistors to store a single bit. Some modern designs implement some or all of their cache using the physically smaller eDRAM, which is slower to use than SRAM but allows larger amounts of cache for any given amount of chip area.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: The memory device with that value, normally implemented in _____, holds that value in a very low-energy form that is not powerful enough to be read directly by the CPU
CPU cache.fact: The memory device with that value, normally implemented in DRAM, holds that value in a very low-energy form that is not powerful enough to be read directly by the CPU. By locating the memory physically closer to the CPU the time needed for the buses to settle is reduced, and by replacing the DRAM with SRAM, which hold the value in a form that does not require amplification to be read, the delay within the memory itself is eliminated.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: A single TLB can be provided for access to both instructions and data, or a separate _____ TLB (ITLB) and data TLB (DTLB) can be provided
CPU cache.fact: Many modern desktop, server, and industrial CPUs have at least three independent levels of caches (L1, L2 and L3) and different types of caches: Translation lookaside buffer (TLB) Used to speed up virtual-to-physical address translation for both executable instructions and data. A single TLB can be provided for access to both instructions and data, or a separate Instruction TLB (ITLB) and data TLB (DTLB) can be provided.

Cryptanalysis.fact: Cryptanalysis (from Greek kryptós 'hidden' and analýein 'to analyze') refers to the process of analyzing information systems in order to understand hidden aspects of the systems. Discrete-time Fourier transform.fact: In simpler terms, when you take the DTFT of regularly-spaced samples of a continuous signal, you get repeating (and possibly overlapping) copies of the signal's frequency spectrum, spaced at intervals corresponding to the sampling frequency. Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: The correct DNSKEY record is authenticated via a chain of trust, starting with a set of verified public keys for the DNS root zone which is the trusted third party. DNS resolvers verify the signature with a public key, stored in a DNSKEY record.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: To implement DNSSEC, several new DNS record types were created or adapted to use with DNSSEC: RRSIG (resource record signature) Contains the DNSSEC signature for a record set. Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: The _____ record is a digital signature of the answer DNS resource record set

Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: The NSEC and NSEC3 records are used to provide cryptographic evidence of the non-existence of any _____ (RR)

Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: The DS record is used in the authentication of _____ in the lookup procedure using the chain of trust

Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: Since the DO bit is in the extended flag bits defined by _____ for DNS (EDNS), RFC 6891, all DNSSEC transactions must support EDNS
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: Since the DO bit is in the extended flag bits defined by Extension Mechanisms for DNS (EDNS), RFC 6891, all DNSSEC transactions must support EDNS.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT

Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: The process starts when a security-aware resolver sets the "DO" ("DNSSEC OK") flag bit in a DNS query. Since the DO bit is in the extended flag bits defined by Extension Mechanisms for DNS (EDNS), RFC 6891, all DNSSEC transactions must support EDNS.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT
Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: Ideally, the security-aware resolver would start with verifying the DS and _____ records at the DNS root
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: Ideally, the security-aware resolver would start with verifying the DS and DNSKEY records at the DNS root. Then it would use the DS records for the "com" top-level domain found at the root to verify the DNSKEY records in the "com" zone.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT
Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: Then it would use the DS records for the "com" top-level domain found at the root to verify the _____ records in the "com" zone
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: Ideally, the security-aware resolver would start with verifying the DS and DNSKEY records at the DNS root. Then it would use the DS records for the "com" top-level domain found at the root to verify the DNSKEY records in the "com" zone.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT
Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: Finally, it would verify the _____ record found in the answer for the A records for "www.example.com"
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: Finally, it would verify the RRSIG record found in the answer for the A records for "www.example.com". First, if "example.com" does not support DNSSEC, there will be no RRSIG record in the answer and there will not be a DS record for "example.com" in the "com" zone.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT
Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: First, if "example.com" does not support _____, there will be no RRSIG record in the answer and there will not be a DS record for "example.com" in the "com" zone
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: First, if "example.com" does not support DNSSEC, there will be no RRSIG record in the answer and there will not be a DS record for "example.com" in the "com" zone. If there is a DS record for "example.com", but no RRSIG record in the reply, something is wrong and maybe a man in the middle attack is going on, stripping the DNSSEC information and modifying the A records.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT
Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: Or, it could be a broken security-oblivious name server along the way that stripped the DO flag bit from the query or the _____ record from the answer
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: First, if "example.com" does not support DNSSEC, there will be no RRSIG record in the answer and there will not be a DS record for "example.com" in the "com" zone. If there is a DS record for "example.com", but no RRSIG record in the reply, something is wrong and maybe a man in the middle attack is going on, stripping the DNSSEC information and modifying the A records.

Or, it could be a broken security-oblivious name server along the way that stripped the DO flag bit from the query or the RRSIG record from the answer.

Domain Name System Security Extensions.subject: Computer & IT
Domain Name System Security Extensions.question: The _____/NSEC3 records have RRSIG records, which can be verified as above
Domain Name System Security Extensions.fact: Next, it may be that there is not a domain name named "www.example.com", in which case instead of returning a RRSIG record in the answer, there will be either an NSEC record or an NSEC3 record. The NSEC/NSEC3 records have RRSIG records, which can be verified as above.
